value.rationale: This is a complete nontrivial infinite-parameter Abelian complexity classification, giving a connected-fiber rigidity principle, exact full residue profile, sharp longest-run phase transition, and cyclic ordering invariance. It precisely resolves how much information is lost by Abelianizing a circular word and is substantially stronger than basic periodic boundedness or a finite table.
